model_manifest.caveat: Width 190mm, rear reach and wood depth are conservative analysis extents. Support friction is provisional. Existing hand collision primitives may omit housing details.
model_manifest.additional_proxy_caveat: Offline sensitivity: convex visual-mesh hulls overapproximate concavities; no cube contacts, no fitted offsets.

limitations: Box clearances and MuJoCo contacts are model diagnostics, not measured physical forces.
The user-estimated marker mount is unchanged; it can bias all projected contacts.
The grid diagnostic assumes a solved green face with equal tile pitch.
Static OFF pose comparison does not establish a safe or successful motor path.
